description: One look at a site from outside: whether the home page answers and how fast (one sample, not monitoring), the TLS certificate (issuer, days left, the names it covers, protocol, TLS 1.0/1.1), the domain's registration expiry from the registry's RDAP service (unknown when the registry doesn't publish it), email authentication (SPF, DMARC, MX, DKIM under common selectors), security headers graded A to F (HSTS, CSP, nosniff, framing, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy), cookies and tracking scripts on first load, a recognised cookie banner and a privacy policy link, http to https forwarding and mixed content. Findings come with plain-word fixes. Not legal advice and not a compliance check. Limited to 30 checks an hour per caller (shared with the other checks); results are cached for 10 minutes.

url.description: the website or page, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page

name: check_site_health
title: Is this website up, secure and set up properly?
